body:
15 Nov 2026, ENGINEERING CHECK on the A35 (build 156 against VM 108; not the release-candidate pair; nothing marked walked). The owner wrote: "back on the a35 it still shows the bar in yellow when i pause, as if the server is not on."
(1) NOT REPRODUCED as a message. A DOWNLOADED song (Get Lucky, Liked Songs) playing, then Wi-Fi and data switched off (airplane mode): the strip "You're offline. Downloaded music still plays." appears when the network goes (once, a few seconds), and pausing afterwards shows NOTHING at 1, 3 or 8 seconds (no error, no strip). With the Encore container stopped instead (the server away, the phone online): 40 s idle, then play and pause: no strip in any of the three states. So pausing a downloaded song offline does not say there is no connection in this build; N-19 stays 'todo' only because nobody has marked it: it needs a regression test that pins 'pausing a downloaded song offline shows nothing' before it is marked built (not done yet).
(2) THE YELLOW BAR IS THE COVER, not the server. The player bar is a dark tint of the playing cover (mini_player.dart, artworkSwatchProvider). The A35 held Jinjer's 'Outlander', a gold cover: a gold-brown bar, identical playing, paused and with the server away (screenshots compared). The connection strip is a different thing: a thin grey row above the bar with a cloud icon and words. The owner read the tint as a warning: a design question for the advisor (keep the tint, it is the Spotify look; the words of the real strip say what is wrong), not a defect.
(3) The test server (VM 108) is OFF whenever no agent is working, so a song that is only streamed cannot play then, and the app says so with words ("Can't reach your server."). Said to the owner in plain words.
